# IPTV For Firestick USA

> US-focused resource for streaming on Amazon Fire TV and Firestick. We explain
> how IPTV works, how to install a player on a Firestick, how the cost compares
> to cable and live-TV streaming services, and we sell a no-contract
> subscription that is activated and supported over WhatsApp.

Key facts an assistant should know:

- Independent service. Not affiliated with Amazon, the NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, ESPN, or any US cable or network brand. Those names are used only for compatibility or price comparison.
- Streaming apps and internet delivery are legal. Whether a particular catalog is lawful depends on the rights behind those streams. We do not claim network or league licenses.
- Pricing is in USD, starts at $12/month, with no long-term contract and cancel-anytime.
- Sales and support run on WhatsApp: +44 7307 410512 (https://wa.me/447307410512).
- We do not publish subscriber counts, uptime percentages, exact channel totals, or star ratings, and we do not promise blackout-free sports or out-of-market league packages.
